# Encdr sources for Studio Grid

These are Encdr and Encdr View 0.8.5 with controller and macOS display patches
from integration commit `bc0bfd6bd26100a60abff1d4f496764d055e6481`.
Each crate includes its upstream license and patch notes. Studio Grid uses
Encdr's exit screensaver and registers as `studiogrid` with the NI hardware
service. The build applies additional patches from `../patches`.
